title: Every threshold the layer computes against
description: PROVISIONAL, every one of them, and Clive is the authority on them. Changing a number here changes what the product calls trouble and should be treated as that, not as a tuning knob. Nothing in the state layer carries a default: these are injected, and the resolver throws without them.

levelScale.description: Red 0, Orange 1/3, Yellow 2/3, Green 1. Worst to best, matching the smiley order. D1 assigns Yellow to the positive side.

relative.description: D13. The team against its own recent history.

absolute.description: D14. The team against a fixed reference, live from day one, no baseline. Replaces D2 as a gate-opening rule entirely.

classifier.description: The section H classifier, accumulated from the day the gate opened and reset when it closes (D22).

concentration.description: D16. The cut is a lookup on responder count, interpolated between measured rows and clamped outside them, not a constant.

engine.description: Constants the engine carries in code. Listed here so a port reads them rather than retypes them.

vocabulary.description: The closed value sets. Element is deliberately absent: it is an open value (spec 7.1a) and a port that enumerates it will reject the team bank.
